notes: Licence read directly, not inferred from the host: the abs page at https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.20542 links http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/, i.e. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, not arXiv's default non-exclusive grant. CC BY-NC-ND permits verbatim redistribution with attribution for non-commercial use, so the PDF is archived. The schema vocabulary has no CC-BY-NC-ND token; preprint-cc-arxiv is the leading token with the real licence in the qualifier. NoDerivatives caveat: the markdown conversion is arguably a derivative and is therefore retained as internal research notes under fair use rather than under the licence grant; only the verbatim PDF rests on the licence. The retrieved PDF is arXiv v2 (5 Feb 2025), whose first page states 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025'; the OpenAlex record and this card's year field use 2024, the first-posting year. Extraction: markitdown on a single-column preprint; running prose is clean but the result tables are broken into pipe fragments, so every quoted number was read against the PDF's own tables.
